description: List sections derived from recorded source headings, preserving their hierarchy. Return titles and identifiers for reading sections or browsing their children.

cursor.description: Continue from a returned next_cursor, keeping all other arguments unchanged.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum sections per page, from 1 to 20.
limit.title: Limit

section_id.description: Parent section whose direct children to list. Omit to list root sections.
section_id.title: Section Id

version_id.description: Text-version ID from a returned passage or work occurrence.
version_id.title: Version Id

name: list_sections
